name: philogg-tauri
description: Experimental Tauri v2 desktop wrapper for philogg.html, parallel to the Electron wrapper in desktop/. Same feature surface (frameless window, .log file associations, tray, settings mirroring), built on the OS webview instead of a bundled Chromium. philogg.html itself is loaded unmodified through a custom philogg:// scheme, exactly like the Electron wrapper does.
